columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text since identifiers are text by convention. A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: Committed contract unchanged; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and 2330 distinct values, consistent with a required text identifier.

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.0 and 2 distinct values (false, true).

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.0 and 3141 distinct values.

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description, whitespace-trimmed; nulls are retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.005098, consistent with optional.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line. Negative values occur both on cancellation-invoice lines and on zero-unit-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not infer cancellation from negative quantity alone.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.0, min -1395, max 5184.

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.description: Invoice timestamp, strictly cast from the landing text representation; an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.0, min 2009-12-01T07:45:00, max 2009-12-23T16:58:00.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price in sterling. Zero-price lines (freebies and adjustments) are retained; negative prices are contract-invalid.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.0, min 0.0, max 1998.49.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier. The bronze null rate is retained as null (guest or unregistered checkouts), not dropped and not imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.300664, consistent with optional.

columns.name: country
columns.rationale: Unchanged; profile shows null_rate 0.0 and 24 distinct values.

columns.name: captured_at
columns.description: Capture timestamp carried forward from the bronze landing (_airbyte_extracted_at): when the surviving line's earliest capture entered the pipeline. The incremental watermark the gold layer builds on. Required: the incremental path is proven to populate this column on every row.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile measures null_rate 0.0 for captured_at over 44,721 rows with 4 distinct capture timestamps, confirming the incremental path has landed and every row carries a captured_at value as the intent states.

quality_rules.rationale: Row count measured at 44,721, well above zero, confirming the table is populated.
duplicate_row_rate measures 0.0 across 44,721 rows; the composite grain (invoice_id, stock_code, quantity, unit_price) is unique by measurement.
Profile shows unit_price min 0.0, max 1998.49; no negative prices observed.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are retained and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate are collapsed to one line with the earliest timestamp retained. customer_id remains null for guest or unregistered checkouts and is retained as null rather than imputed.
